stances.quote: I believe that our nation must maintain a strong and robust military, which is crucial for protecting the interests of our nation at home and abroad. I support providing our servicemembers with the key resources they need to be successful in their missions.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly endorses maintaining a strong military and providing servicemembers with needed resources, indicating support for more defense spending.

stances.quote: One of my most important priorities in Congress is to restore the full State and Local Tax (SALT) Deduction... Restoring the SALT Deduction will get more dollars back in the pockets of hard working, middle-class New Jersey families.
stances.reasoning: Repeated emphasis on restoring SALT deduction to return money to taxpayers shows clear support for lower effective taxes.
